evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Position-holder issues a binding cadence directive and frames non-compliance as loss of capability — authority of position plus insistence.
Recorder supplies the factual cadence specification, controlling the facts of the directive — no influence attempt on an audience.
Recorder supplies the ownership assignment as fact — informational control of the record, not an influence attempt.

mints.name: RehearsalAsPossession
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted by equating non-rehearsal with non-possession of a capability?
